featured_reviews.name: kalindi multani
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a large tray gift wrapped with multiple items, expecting basic care and professionalism. Instead, the entire tray was damaged and worse, water had leaked inside, completely ruining the packaging and staining the clothes and gifts!!! This wasn’t a minor issue, it destroyed the purpose of the gift entirely.

What’s even more disappointing is the complete lack of accountability. Not only did they refuse to acknowledge the mistake, but they also didn’t offer a refund, replacement, or even a basic apology. The response was dismissive and unprofessional.

Mistakes can happen but how a business handles them is what defines their integrity. In this case, there was zero ownership, zero customer care, and frankly, very poor behavior.

Would strongly advise others to think twice before trusting them with anything important or gift-related.

featured_reviews.name: binoy varghese
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased this stained-glass star, and it has truly exceeded my expectations. The craftsmanship is excellent — the glass panels have vibrant shades of blue and green that catch the light beautifully, giving a warm, festive glow to the entire corner of my décor. The metal framing feels sturdy and well-finished, adding to its premium look.

What I appreciate most is how effortlessly it enhances the ambiance. Whether lit or unlit, it stands out as a stunning decorative piece. The hanging chain is strong and the overall build gives a very handcrafted, artisanal feel.

It has become a perfect focal point above my nativity setup, adding just the right touch of elegance and Christmas charm. Completely worth the purchase — highly recommended for anyone looking to elevate their festive decorations!

I also want to appreciate the staff / owner  who assisted me before the purchase. She took the time to call me, patiently show a live video demo of the star, and explain the details clearly. Her  courteous approach and willingness to help gave me complete confidence in placing the order. It’s rare to experience such personalised customer service these days, and it made a big difference.
